Arm-2026-17605.title: Software Technology Manager - AI Tool Chain
Arm-2026-17605.description:
Job Overview:
Arm presents an outstanding opportunity for a Software Technology Manager in China, to guide our AI tool chain developer ecosystem for Arm-based AI platforms. This role blends AI software, silicon platforms, developer ecosystems, and production deployment, placing you at the center of innovation and tech progress.
You will work closely with Partnerships, Solution Architects, Business Units, engineering teams, and ecosystem partners in automotive and robotics. Your main responsibility will be converting partner needs and ecosystem opportunities into clear engineering requirements, spotting technology and product gaps, and offering helpful feedback for product refinement. This role plays a vital part in guaranteeing Day-0/Day-1 readiness for Arm-based AI platforms and speeding up partner adoption.
The ideal candidate will bring practical knowledge of real-world on-device AI deployment use cases, such as mobile/laptop, smart cockpits, autonomous driving, and robotics. You should deeply understand the difficulties in onboarding or transitioning customers to new AI silicon platforms, covering AI model adaptation, operator compatibility, quantization accuracy, and performance optimization.
Responsibilities:
Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to engage AI ecosystem, identify deployment requirements, and capture developer AI tool chain needs.
Translate AI deployment requests into actionable technical requirements and roadmaps for internal engineering teams.
Lead model adaptation, migration, and deployment workflows, including optimization, quantization, custom operator support, and performance tuning.
Represent the China developer ecosystem needs, delivering insights and technical feedback to guide Arm’s product strategy.
Conduct competitive analysis of AI tooling and ecosystem adoption, detailing feedback to guide product and engineering roadmaps.
Drive and build the high quality demos and developer work flow to show case Arm’s AI technology
Arm-2026-17605.requirements:
Demonstrated background in technology management, customer engineering, developer/solution engineer, or related positions.
Strong grasp of LLM/CNN and AI software tool chains, encompassing frameworks, runtime, model quantization, and deployment workflows.
Proven Hands-on experience with AI silicon platforms and the on-device AI tool chain flow, knowledgeable about deployment issues such as operator compatibility and performance tuning.
Strong ownership and structured thinking, translating ambiguous requirements into structured technical plans and execution.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, simplifying complex topics for diverse audiences.
Ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior collaborators.
Proficiency in English and Mandarin.
Desired Skills and Experience:
Experience with AI technology ecosystems in on-device AI, especially regarding heterogeneous computing and AI runtime improvement.
Proven track record of building customer AI model deployments, hands-on experience with frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow.
Experience with automotive and robotics software platforms and stacks is a bonus.
In Return:
Arm offers a collaborative and inclusive working environment where you will have the opportunity to work on innovative technology and influence the future of AI deployment. Join us and be part of a team that drives innovation and makes a real impact in the world of AI technology

Arm-2026-17532.title: Senior Director, Physical AI - GTM (China Market)
Arm-2026-17532.description:
Arm is looking for a China GTM Lead to drive adoption of our compute platform across the next generation of robotics and autonomous systems. Our customers are building innovative, real-world AI systems—humanoid robots, industrial automation, AVs, drones, with more Physical AI innovation on the way. Arm’s GTM team deeply engages with customers to understand their challenges and help translate those challenges to the product requirements for our product management organization.
The GTM role at Arm is responsible for complete customer success including early engagement, product fit alignment, crafting commercial deals all to way to helping shape the customers' success with their product through ensuring a balanced silicon and software ecosystem. While a customer facing role, the right candidate will have a technical enough background to be able to present Arm’s product roadmaps. In this role you’ll work directly with customers and a matrix of Arm’s internal teams to help Arm scale the business to become the default platform for physical AI.
Responsibilities:
Own the China GTM strategy for robotics & autonomy with a focus on driving wins and long-term revenue
Refine priority segments (e.g., industrial robotics, humanoids, AMRs, AVs, drones)
Identify and prioritize target accounts and design-in opportunities while positioning our platform for success among competitors
Lead strategic deals from early engagement through design win and production
Navigate sophisticated buying groups: hardware, software, AI, and executive sponsors
Support customers through discovery, evaluation, benchmarking, and integration
Build the local developer and partner ecosystem through partnership with product and engineering to ensure strong roadmap, SDK, tooling, and AI framework support
Build partnerships with robotics software stacks (ROS, simulation platforms, autonomy stacks)
Enable system integrators, ODMs, and reference design partners
Bridge gaps between product, engineering, and go-to-market teams
Translate customer requirements (performance, power, latency, safety) into product direction
Influence roadmap based on real-world workloads (perception, planning, control)
Help define reference architectures and use-case-specific optimizations
Develop scalable GTM infrastructure that includes technical messaging, benchmarks, and dynamic market positioning
Scope reference designs, solution briefs, and vertical-specific playbooks
Arm-2026-17532.requirements:
7–15+ years in GTM, business development, or product roles in semiconductors or deep tech
Experience working with robotics, autonomous systems, automotive, or edge AI
Track record of working with Sales to secure design wins or platform adoption
Familiarity with Tier 1s, OEMs, and startup ecosystems
Skilled in intricate deal structuring and strategic partnerships
Appreciation for developer experience as a GTM lever
Proven history of collaboration with partners (ISVs, ODMs, system integrators)
Nice to Have:
Experience at a semiconductor company or selling silicon platforms
Background in AI/ML workloads on edge devices
Exposure to functional safety (ISO 26262) or robotics safety standards

Arm-2026-17483.description:
Job Overview
At Arm, we develop technology that enables AI and applications to run across billions of devices worldwide, from cloud to edge.
We are looking for an AI Software Engineer to optimize AI frameworks and enable efficient model deployment on Arm-based platforms. This role combines machine learning, systems engineering, and developer enablement, helping partners bring AI applications to edge, mobile, and other computing environments.
You will work hands-on with model optimization, framework and runtime integration, and cross-platform validation. Working closely with partners and Arm engineering teams, you will enable early adoption of emerging Arm technologies, including through virtual and pre-silicon platforms where appropriate.
Your analysis of application performance and system behavior will help improve Arm software, tools, and future hardware, while reusable demonstrations and technical guidance will support broader ecosystem adoption.
Key Responsibilities
Enable partner and open-source AI models and applications on Arm-based platforms through framework, runtime, and SDK integration.
Optimize model execution through techniques such as quantization, graph optimization, operator fusion, tiling, and memory optimization.
Profile and debug workloads across applications, frameworks, runtimes, and hardware interfaces to identify performance and compatibility issues.
Build reproducible workflows for cross-platform validation and benchmarking, assessing accuracy, latency, throughput, memory usage, and power efficiency where measurable.
Collaborate with partners and internal teams to enable emerging Arm technologies, resolve adoption challenges, and share findings through demos, technical guides, and engineering reports.
Arm-2026-17483.requirements:
Strong software engineering experience in AI deployment, inference frameworks, runtimes, or performance optimization.
Practical understanding of neural networks, including transformer-based models or CNNs, and experience optimizing models for resource-constrained devices.
Hands-on experience with AI frameworks and deployment tools such as PyTorch, ONNX Runtime, LiteRT, ExecuTorch, or vendor-specific SDKs.
Strong Python and C/C++ skills, with experience developing and debugging software on Linux or Android.
Experience profiling AI workloads across software layers, identifying bottlenecks, and validating optimization results against accuracy and performance baselines.
Strong analytical, communication, and documentation skills, with the flexibility to work across partner applications and collaborate with external engineering teams.
Preferred Skills and Background
Experience with Arm architecture, Arm AI software tools, or optimization for CPUs, NPUs, and other accelerators.
Understanding of hardware and system performance, including compute utilization, memory bandwidth, interconnects, and thermal constraints.
Experience with model compression, pruning, LoRA/PEFT, or low-level kernel and inference-backend optimization.
Familiarity with automotive or robotics AI applications, embedded systems, or virtual and pre-silicon development environments.
Contributions to open-source frameworks or developer ecosystems through code, technical publications, tutorials, or demonstrations.
Education
A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Arm-2026-19573.title: Graduate Applications Engineer
Arm-2026-19573.description:
Job Overview:
Applications Engineers at Arm have the outstanding opportunity to work on groundbreaking technology, enabling our partners to develop world-class SoC designs using Arm System IP. This role is dynamic and deeply technical, providing mentorship on IP integration, configuration, and performance to Arm’s collaborators. You will be responsible for investigating issues, identifying solutions through RTL simulations, and clearly communicating your findings.
Your role as a Graduate Applications Engineer will involve understanding customers' goals, examining their requests and problems, and offering solutions that promote progress. You'll face diverse technical challenges every day, working on a range of products.
What you could be doing as an Applications Engineer Graduate?
Offer quick and accurate replies to partner questions related to Arm System IP
Prepare and present technical training workshops on Arm System IP, delivered onsite and remotely
Perform customer SoC build reviews using ARM IP and provide functionality and optimisation recommendations, working onsite as well as from remote locations
Work with Arm IP build and product management teams to improve partners' experience and influence IP feature development
Test IP work and provide feedback to the established team prior to release to customers
Build and modify web-based knowledge base articles and application notes
Develop tools and techniques to aid Application Engineers in solving problems more efficiently
We are looking for individuals who:
Hold (or are on track to hold) a University degree or equivalent experience by the programme start date. This can be Bachelors, Masters or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical or Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering. Candidates with alternative degrees will also be considered if they have relevant experience.
Qualities that will help your application stand out:
Good knowledge of computer architecture and SoC build principles
Experience or knowledge of ASIC or FPGA build
Excellent understanding of HDLs such as Verilog, SystemVerilog or VHDL
Ability to use RTL simulation tools for debugging purposes
Familiarity with tools like Visual Studio Code, Vim/text editor flow, waveform viewers like Questasim, Verdi, Cadence Simvision, Xcelium
Proficient in English, with clear and effective written and verbal communication skills
Ability to work with remote teams
Additional Information
We encourage early applications as we review them on a first-come, first-served basis.
In Return:
You’ll receive a comprehensive rewards package. As you grow in the role, you’ll find clear prospects to increase your salary within the range at Arm. With mid-year and year-end reviews, you’ll have two scheduled opportunities each year to reflect your progress.
You can also attend our “Grad-teach-Grads” workshops, guest speaker series, and social events to expand your knowledge. If you’d like to get more involved, you can join the Graduate Committee to further develop your planning, networking, and coordination skills.
You’ll be encouraged to attend our Global Graduate Conference (GGC) — an annual event where graduates hear from executive leaders, guest speakers, and build lasting connections.
Many of our leaders and technical specialists began their careers as Graduates; could you be the next?

Arm-2026-18919.description:
Job Overview:
We are seeking a highly motivated Staff Applications Engineer specializing in Performance Analysis. This role offers an outstanding chance to help customers achieve world-class performance and efficiency on Arm AGI CPU platforms and other Arm SoC products!
In this position, you will collaborate closely with customers, software partners, and internal engineering groups to address performance problems. You will improve workloads and assist in deploying applications on Arm-based systems successfully. Your knowledge of system performance analysis, CPU and GPU design, and workload tuning will help customers realize the full capabilities of Arm SoC.
The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth with excellent communication skills and a passion for solving sophisticated customer challenges.
Responsibilities:
Customer Support:
Interact directly with customers to grasp application performance needs and deployment obstacles.
Analyze and resolve intricate workload performance issues across the application, operating system, runtime, and hardware stack.
Support customer blocking issues involving performance bottlenecks, scalability issues, and workload migration challenges.
Deliver performance findings, optimization recommendations, and standard process mentorship to customers.
Workload Enablement and Optimization:
Support customers in migrating, validating, and optimizing workloads on Arm AGI CPU platforms.
Find opportunities to improve application performance, resource utilization, scalability, and power efficiency.
Analyze workload behavior and optimize CPU, memory, cache, storage, and I/O performance.
Support a wide range of workloads including AI/ML inference and training, cloud-native applications, databases and analytics, High Performance Computing (HPC), enterprise and web services, and virtualized and containerized environments.
Performance Assessment and Evaluation:
Perform system-level performance investigations using industry-standard profiling and tracing tools.
Analyze PMU data, CPU pipeline behavior, cache efficiency, memory bandwidth utilization, and NUMA characteristics.
Complete benchmarking studies to evaluate workload performance and identify optimization opportunities.
Develop consistent approaches for performance characterization and root-cause analysis.
Collaboration and Technical Leadership:
Collaborate closely with Arm architecture, silicon, firmware, kernel, compiler, and software ecosystem groups.
Provide customer feedback to product and engineering organizations to improve future Arm solutions.
Contribute to performance tuning guides, guidelines, and customer enablement materials.
Mentor junior engineers on performance analysis techniques and Arm optimization methodologies.

Arm-2026-19575.description:
Job Description
Impact the visual quality and performance of games on billions of Arm-based devices. Join Arm’s Developer Platforms team to bring graphics technologies into mobile games. This position is part of the Strategy and Ecosystems group, contributing to the delivery of an outstanding developer experience for graphics and gaming applications on Arm.

This role demands practical experience in real-time graphics and game engines, as well as the capability to explain technical trade-offs clearly and work together effectively. Work closely with internal teams and game or engine partners. Collaborate onsite to bring Arm software and graphics solutions into popular games. Support these solutions from prototype to deployment.
Job

Strong programming skills in C/C++ and Python, with experience writing maintainable software.
Strong understanding of computer graphics and real-time rendering, including the graphics pipeline, shaders, and GPU-based workloads.
Significant experience with a game engine such as Unreal Engine or Unity, including integrating runtime code or graphics features.
Strong debugging and profiling skills, an understanding of Arm Mali or other GPU architectures, and clear written and verbal communication in English and Chinese.
Desired Skills and Experience:
Proven game-development experience, preferably with commercial mobile games and performance-constrained devices.
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum and collaborative research-to-product development.

Job Overview:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Events & Audience Acquisition Manager to join our global events team. In this role, you will deliver high-impact Arm events and contribute to the planning of outstanding event experiences, bringing strong execution skills and a diligent, collaborative demeanor.
This role is vital to the events team and is mainly responsible for leading a portfolio of industry exhibitions and Arm-organized gatherings in China. It also supports key regional and global projects. The position coordinates all phases of event execution year-round and offers expertise and mentorship on event management tools and platforms. This ensures smooth planning, teamwork, and steady support for the broader team.
Key Responsibilities:
End-to-end delivery of diverse events and multidimensional projects, including industry tradeshows and Arm-hosted events. This includes venue research, space planning, agenda coordination, deco arrangement, logistics, and budget tracking. You will also support efforts to attract the target audience and pre-event promotion to improve reach across relevant channels and ensure strong event attendance and impact.
Lead and support event digital & technology platforms (e.g., event websites, registration pages, attendee hub, Asana follow up and meeting management tools) for both event and marketing teams.
Apply guidelines in event planning and process management, finding opportunities to streamline workflows and improve operational efficiency.
Build and maintain effective working relationships alongside colleagues and partners both inside and outside the organization across all projects.
Collaborate within the distributed team to deliver core elements of large-scale Arm events, including accommodation, catering, shipping, session coordination, and satellite events.
Partner with internal BUs to complete relevant technology demonstrations at events.

Arm-2026-17194.description:
Job Overview
As a Principal Field Applications Engineer, you will be the primary technical contact for customers evaluating, designing and deploying server-class Arm silicon. You will support platform bring-up and performance analysis, working with customer teams and Arm engineering colleagues to resolve technical issues and inform product improvements.
Responsibilities
Lead customer product evaluations, from goal-setting and pre-delivery readiness through execution, remote support and closeout.
Establish platform readiness and acceptance criteria covering the BMC, console, firmware, boot path and diagnostics.
Support platform bring-up, characterisation and debugging across hardware, firmware, kernel, operating system and workload layers.
Triage and prioritise customer issues, gather debug evidence and work with engineering teams on resolution.
Characterise workloads and analyse performance for cloud, AI infrastructure and enterprise applications, including compute, memory, I/O, power and thermal bottlenecks.
Review customer system architectures, integration plans and hardware and software bring-up requirements.
Deliver technical training, workshops and enablement for customer engineering teams and partners.
Translate customer and field feedback into product improvements, roadmap priorities and technical support content.
Arm-2026-17194.requirements:
A degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering or computer science, or equivalent practical experience, together with knowledge of server-class CPU architecture, caches, memory, PCIe, NUMA and platform technologies.
Experience bringing up and debugging server platforms across hardware and software, including Linux, firmware, operating systems, scripting and system diagnostics.
Experience characterising workloads and analysing CPU and system bottlenecks, including memory bandwidth, latency and power-performance trade-offs.
Experience supporting customers from pre-sales evaluation through silicon deployment, managing technical issues and explaining trade-offs to engineering and executive audiences while collaborating with engineering, sales and product teams.
Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience
A master's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science or a related technical discipline.
Familiarity with Arm Neoverse architecture, microarchitecture and extensions such as SVE, SVE2, SME and virtualisation.
Experience with AI infrastructure, cloud-native applications, databases, virtualisation, networking, storage or CPU performance in accelerator-based systems.
Experience running industry-standard benchmarks such as SPEC CPU 2017 and analysing performance metrics to optimise systems.
Knowledge of UEFI, OpenBMC, Python, hardware debug equipment and schematic or PCB viewer tools.
Experience working with server OEMs, ODMs, hyperscalers or data centre infrastructure providers on platform integration and deployment.
Experience collaborating with teams across the US, Europe, China and Japan.
In Return
This role offers the opportunity to work across server hardware and software, support customer deployments and use field feedback to inform product improvements and roadmap priorities.
Additional Information
Please note that no relocation package is available for this role.

Arm-2026-19790.description:
Job Overview
As Principal Solutions Architect for gaming, you will lead solutions architecture for the gaming industry within Arm's Developer Ecosystem organisation. This customer-facing technical leadership role connects game developers and engine partners with teams across Arm.
You will turn Arm technology into practical solutions for individual game titles, identify gaming use cases and bring customer requirements and technical insights into product, tooling and developer enablement priorities.
Responsibilities
Define and lead technical engagements with game developers, publishers, studios and ecosystem partners, from early discovery through solution definition, technical alignment and adoption planning.
Work with Gaming Business Development to understand customers' title roadmaps, engine stacks, target devices, performance goals and commercial priorities. Recommend Arm technologies and develop solution narratives, reference architectures and integration approaches.
Lead technical discovery with game teams, exploring rendering pipelines, content, performance bottlenecks, power and thermal constraints, device coverage, timelines and release risks.
Work with Developer Relations engineers to validate and prioritise customer needs, translating field insights into product requests, technical requirements, use cases and success criteria.
Coordinate with GPU architecture, performance, software, tools, product management and engineering teams to develop technically credible solutions suited to customer priorities.
Connect game workloads and customer challenges to Arm technology directions, identifying repeatable use cases that can inform SDKs, plugins, documentation, samples and developer tools.
Provide architecture-level guidance on GPU performance, power efficiency, thermal behaviour, frame pacing, memory bandwidth and quality trade-offs across mobile and other Arm-based gaming platforms.
Communicate technical plans, dependencies, risks and decisions to customers and internal teams. Capture engagement learnings and develop reusable playbooks and solution assets.
Arm-2026-19790.requirements:
Experience in solutions architecture, graphics engineering, game technology, GPU software, developer technology or a related customer-facing technical role, with the ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and communicate with technical and business stakeholders.
Knowledge of Arm Mali GPUs and their hardware and software ecosystem, including graphics APIs, drivers, tools and performance considerations.
Understanding of real-time rendering and game-engine rendering pipelines, with practical familiarity with Unreal Engine and Unity. Ability to analyse and optimise GPU performance, including frame pacing, memory bandwidth, shader cost and CPU/GPU workload balance.
Understanding of power, thermal constraints and sustained performance for game content, particularly on mobile. Ability to structure technical discovery, diagnose customer problems and translate findings into solution options and prioritised requirements.
Nice-to-Have Skills and Experience
Experience optimising commercial games on mobile.
Experience with Vulkan, OpenGL ES, DirectX, Metal, shader programming, profiling or graphics debugging tools.
Knowledge of rendering techniques such as upscaling, frame generation, neural rendering, ray tracing, global illumination, compression or adaptive quality systems.
Familiarity with developer resources such as SDKs, engine plugins, integration guides, sample code, tutorials, validation suites or technical training.
Experience working with Chinese and global game studios, publishers, engine providers, silicon partners or OEM ecosystems.
Experience influencing product roadmaps using customer evidence, market insights and technical requirements.
A master's degree or higher in a relevant technical field.
In Return
You will work with game teams and colleagues across Arm to solve title-specific technical challenges. Your work will also help shape reusable developer resources and bring customer evidence into Arm's product and tooling priorities.

Arm-2026-17606.title: Senior Partnership Specialist
Arm-2026-17606.description:
Job Overview:
We are seeking a Strategic Alliances Lead to drive partnerships across the AI software
stack in China, ensuring AI frameworks, models, and applications are optimized and
ready on Day 1 of new Arm hardware launches. In this role, you will drive engagement
with independent software vendors (ISVs), AI framework developers, technology
partners, and internal teams to create a seamless ecosystem that enhances
performance, compatibility, and adoption of AI workloads on Arm-based platforms in
China.
Responsibilities:
• Develop and implement partnership strategies with AI ISVs, framework
developers, and software ecosystem players in China to ensure AI software is
optimized for Arm hardware.
• Drive partner recruitment efforts, identifying and engaging strategic software
partners in the AI domain, with a focus on the unique needs of the China AI
ecosystem.
• Work closely with engineering teams, product managers, and developer
relations to facilitate technical enablement and readiness efforts for AI
workloads in China.
• Define and measure the success of AI strategic alliance efforts and identify areas
for improvement.
• Manage relationships with AI software companies in China, building mutual
alignment and successful execution of co-engineering projects.
• Coordinate go-to-market activities with partners, including joint announcements,
marketing initiatives, and developer outreach, ensuring end-to-end ownership of
the partnership process in China.
Arm-2026-17606.requirements:
• Proven experience in business development, alliances, or partner management
within the AI, software, or semiconductor industry in China.
• Strong understanding of AI frameworks, model optimization, and hardware software interactions, with specific knowledge of the China AI market.
• Familiarity with Arm architectures and their advantages for AI performance and
efficiency, particularly within the China ecosystem.
• Excellent communication and relationship management skills, able to engage
technical and non-technical stakeholders in China.
• Ability to analyze market trends and influence strategic decisions based on AI
software readiness needs specific to China.
• Experience working with AI ISVs, open-source communities, or AI software
ecosystem enablement initiatives in China.
• Fluency in Mandarin and English, with strong cross-cultural communication skills.
• Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and drive results in
a fast-paced environment.
“Nice To Have” Skills and Experience:
• Experience in AI software development or technical marketing within China.
• Background in cloud AI, mobile AI, or embedded AI ecosystems, with knowledge
of leading Chinese AI players and platforms.
• Previous experience working with hardware vendors to drive AI software
adoption in China.
In Return:
• Collaborate with a dedicated team of engineers, developers, and industry
experts to make a tangible impact in the China AI compute ecosystem.
• Be part of a culture that values collaboration, diversity, and innovation, providing
a supportive environment where your contributions are recognized and
celebrated.
